concerns.text: T025c1/T025c2 mandate loading `data/processed/final_models.pkl` (trained on the single held-out split in T020a) for SC-003 feature importance analysis. The Spec (SC-003) and Constitution (Principle VII) require measuring importance against the full population to ensure statistical validity. Using a model trained on a single 80/20 split violates the 'Toxicological Statistical Rigor' constraint by introducing split-specific variance into the feature importance metric, effectively weakening the SC-003 requirement.

FR-004 mandates a 'maximal dissimilarity split' for a held-out test set. The tasks implement two distinct strategies: T018a (Single Split) and T018c (K-Fold). The tasks fail to explicitly map FR-004's 'held-out test set' requirement to the Single Split (T018a) for the final report metrics, while using K-Fold (T018c) solely for the statistical test (FR-005). This ambiguity risks the implementation deriving the 'held-out' report metrics from the K-Fold data, violating the strict separation of concerns required by FR-004 and FR-005.

T013b (writing `sample_size_status.json`) is marked as failed/missing. This artifact is the critical trigger for the 'Data Scarcity' edge case defined in the Spec. Without this file, downstream tasks (T025a1, T029a1) cannot verify the 'Low Sample Size' condition, breaking the acceptance criteria for the edge case handling and violating the Spec's requirement to skip statistical tests if n < 50.

T020b (evaluating the Final Model on the Test Set) is marked as failed/missing. This task is the sole producer of `data/processed/final_test_metrics.json`, which is required by T024a to calculate the descriptive metrics for the single held-out set (FR-004). The absence of this task means FR-004's evaluation requirement is unverified and the final report cannot be generated as specified.

T039 (updating `research.md` with reviewer response) is marked as failed/missing. The Spec and Constitution require addressing reviewer concerns regarding measurement uncertainty and calibration. The absence of this task leaves the project non-compliant with the review process and the specific feedback loop defined in the project governance.
